description: Search or list the metrics (charts) of one asset, BTC by default, by words in query or by category. The same rows as get_asset_metrics: each has the exact metric id, name, unit, intervals, history and the plan its data needs; fetch_metric reads rows whose plan is free.

asset.description: Asset code, for example BTC or ETH; get_assets_list gives every code with its name.

category.description: A metric family, for example market, supply or mining; the categories field of each answer lists them with their counts. Leave it out for every family.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; leave it out for the first page.

query.description: Words to search for in metric names, ids and descriptions, for example "puell", "exchange balance" or "long liquidations". Leave it out to list every metric.

name: get_metrics_list
title: Get metrics list
